AboutPage.intro: A tech review site on a mission to honestly review phones, monitors, laptops and accessories — helping you pick the right product without wasting money.

mission.title: Why do we do this?
mission.p1: Vietnam's tech market is flooded with ads and sponsored reviews. It is hard to find a truly honest review before spending millions — or tens of millions — of dong.
mission.p2: {site} was created to change that. Every review lays out the specs, pros and cons, and scores the product against the same set of criteria — we never take money from brands in exchange for opinions or scores.
mission.p3: Our goal is simple: help you make smarter buying decisions, save money and be happier with the product you choose.

AboutPage.valuesIntro: The principles behind every article we publish.

independent.title: Independent Scores
independent.desc: We never take money from brands or retailers in exchange for opinions or scores. Affiliate links do not affect product rankings.

consistent.title: One Set of Criteria
consistent.desc: Every product is scored out of 10 on the same 4 criteria: design, performance, battery & durability, and value — so you can compare fairly.

honest.title: We Name the Downsides
honest.desc: Every review includes clear specs, pros and cons. If you spot a mistake, let us know and we will fix it.

local.title: Made for Vietnam
local.desc: Reviews reflect the needs of buyers in Vietnam — local prices, where to buy, after-sales service and in-country warranty.

AboutPage.scoringIntro: Each product gets an overall score out of 10, based on the criteria below.

design.title: Design
design.desc: Build quality, materials, size, weight and how practical it is in everyday use.

performance.title: Performance
performance.desc: How well the product does its main job: speed, smoothness, display quality, accuracy.

battery.title: Battery & durability
battery.desc: Battery life (for battery-powered devices), durability and warranty terms in Vietnam.

value.title: Value
value.desc: What you get for the money, compared with similarly priced options on the Vietnamese market.

AboutPage.commissionBody: Some links on this website are affiliate links — we may earn a commission when you buy, at no extra cost to you. Commission rates, or whether a product has an affiliate link at all, never affect scores or rankings.
